cohort: The study included pregnant women aged >=18 years who were admitted to the maternity ward between March 2020 and September 2023, with routine SARS-CoV-2 screening.
finding: COVID-19 infection in pregnant women was associated with increased maternal morbidity and mortality, a higher risk of adverse perinatal outcomes (especially preterm birth), and persistent symptoms for many.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more frequent in pregnant women with COVID-19 who were admitted to the ICU.
followup_time: at least 6 months (for persistence of symptoms)
